preparation_signature_search.method: Search the WHOLE 8860-cell population for a cell that re-ignites at a site which had a prior heat source within 3 km that went quiet at least 6 h earlier.
preparation_signature_search.circularity_correction: Running this over the 199 independent ORIGINS returns exactly 0 by construction, because an origin is DEFINED as being 5 km or more from any prior fire. That zero is an artefact of the definition, not a finding, and reporting it as a result would have been a false negative. The search is run over all cells instead.
preparation_signature_search.hard_limitation: The public FIRMS feed is a 7-day rolling archive opening 2026-08-22 00:52 UTC, so usable lead time before the Jijel outbreak is about two days. PREPARATION OVER WEEKS OR MONTHS IS OUTSIDE THIS DATASET ENTIRELY AND CANNOT BE SEARCHED FOR HERE. A negative result means only 'no short-lead precursor inside a two-day window', never 'no preparation'.
preparation_signature_search.interpretation: A prior heat source at a site that dies out and later re-appears is AMBIGUOUS. The dominant benign explanation is rekindle from a residual smouldering source after incomplete suppression, which is very common in deep duff and root systems. It is also what a failed or trial ignition would look like. Thermal data alone cannot separate the two, and the distinction requires ground examination.

burn_scar_shape_test.claim: A circulating claim, appearing in an opinion column and on social media rather than in any official or news report, holds that one burn scar traced the shape of the Algerian flag.
burn_scar_shape_test.why_it_is_testable: The Algerian flag carries a CRESCENT AND STAR. A burn scar reproducing it would be strongly non-convex, would enclose a large unburnt core inside a crescent arm, and would have to hold that figure against wind and terrain. Those properties are measurable.
burn_scar_shape_test.what_the_numbers_show: Every mapped scar has LOW circularity and a LOW enclosed-unburnt fraction: they are ragged, elongated, wind-aligned lobes with no enclosed core. That is the expected geometry of a fire pushed by a sustained wind across broken terrain. No scar shows the enclosed-crescent topology the claim requires.
burn_scar_shape_test.physical_argument: A fire front cannot hold a designed outline. Its shape is set by wind vector, slope, fuel continuity and suppression, all of which vary hour to hour. Producing a recognisable emblem across tens of square kilometres would require controlling the fire perimeter to a precision that is not achievable even by firefighting agencies.
burn_scar_shape_test.how_such_images_arise: Pareidolia on a low-resolution or heavily processed image, arbitrary framing and rotation of a crop, colour-stretching that turns a burn scar red and unburnt vegetation green, or an outright fabricated overlay. None of these can be assessed without the original file and its provenance.
burn_scar_shape_test.status: UNVERIFIED CLAIM, NOT SUPPORTED BY THE BURN-SCAR DATA. It is not used as evidence anywhere in this report, in either direction.

weather_tracking.question: Do the 199 national ignitions sit at the severe tail of the fire-weather field, or are they placed independently of it?
weather_tracking.null_model: random points in the same domain, evaluated in the SAME HOUR as each ignition, so diurnal and synoptic cycles are controlled
weather_tracking.asymmetry_note: This test can only produce strong evidence in one direction. A weather-INDIFFERENT result would be strong evidence for a deliberate driver and would contradict the weather-driven finding. A weather-TRACKING result is consistent both with weather-driven accumulation and with an actor who exploits fire weather, so it cannot separate those two.

1h.verdict: EXCESS synchrony beyond weather + overpass schedule

3h.verdict: EXCESS synchrony beyond weather + overpass schedule

synchrony_robustness.interpretation: Null C is decisive because it holds every detection time exactly as observed and shuffles only the region labels, so the shared national diurnal and synoptic rhythm is preserved perfectly. Any excess surviving Null C would be genuine region-to-region synchronisation. Any excess that appears only under the weather-driven Null A is an artefact of that null being too flat in time.

counter_detection_power.test: cross-region synchrony, region-label permutation null, 1 h window
counter_detection_power.reading: K is the number of coordinated ignitions injected across at least two regions. Power is the fraction of injections the test would flag at p<0.05. A campaign SMALLER than the 80%-power threshold is invisible to this analysis, so the negative synchrony finding does NOT exclude it.
counter_detection_power.honest_limitation: Every classic arson indicator used in chapters 15-21 - compressed timing, a single ignition axis, roadside set-point chains, tactical topographic placement - describes an UNSOPHISTICATED actor. An operation designed to evade detection would disperse in time, cross administrative boundaries, use single-point ignitions and avoid conspicuous terrain. Absence of the naive signature is therefore weak evidence against a competent operation, and the dispersed-profile power curve quantifies exactly how weak.
counter_detection_power.permutation_null_blindness: The label-permutation null conditions on the observed set of detection times. A campaign igniting simultaneously across regions creates a temporal clump but no region-time association, so permuting labels inside the clump reproduces the same statistic. The null absorbs the very signal it was built to find. The flat zero power curves are the direct consequence.

observability_limit.consequence: Ignition time is knowable only to within the blind window. With a median window of 3.5 h, an operation igniting within 30 minutes and a set of unrelated fires starting over several hours produce IDENTICAL satellite observations. Simultaneity at the resolution a campaign hypothesis needs is therefore not measurable from polar-orbiter data at all - this is an observability limit, not an analytical shortcoming.

national_scale_analysis.bottom_line: تعدّد بؤر الاشتعال هو الخلفية الوطنية الدائمة صيفاً (199 بؤرة مستقلة، 7–58 يومياً) وليس شذوذاً. والاشتعالات تتبّع حقل طقس الحرائق بقوة (p=1e-23). لكن اختبار التزامن — المؤشر المركزي لفرضية التنسيق — قوّته صفر عملياً، ووسيط النافذة العمياء 3.48 ساعة يجعل التزامن غير قابل للقياس أصلاً. فالفرضية لم تُدحض، بل لم تُختبر اختباراً ذا قوة. المدى المعقول لاحتمالها 11٪–26٪.

graph.bias_note: shortest-time routing at free-flow speed, no traffic, no stop penalty, no darkness penalty - biased in favour of the single-actor hypothesis

serial_line_test.interpretation_note: A chain of roadside set-points should show HIGH elongation AND a high fraction of cells within ~100-250 m of one road. An areal wind-driven front shows moderate elongation with cells distributed independently of the road network.

coordinated_arson_signature.verdict: لم يتحقّق أيّ من المؤشرات العشرة المتوقّعة من عملية إجرامية منسّقة متعدّدة الخلايا. وضعف الاحتمال ليس تبرئة: الأدلة الحاسمة خارج هذه المجموعة بكاملها.

osint_scope_isolation.scope_rule: Only items whose publication date is verifiably inside or immediately after 24-29 Aug 2026 AND whose subject matter is the Jijel/east-Algeria fires of that window are admitted. Every other item is quarantined.

quarantined_out_of_scope.claim: Video clips 'purportedly showing perpetrators setting the fires'; 'images of burned tyres found inside the forests'; 'a video filmed by an amateur showing a person leaving the vicinity of a forest while flames were burning behind him'
quarantined_out_of_scope.why_excluded: Appears only in an OPINION column (Asharq Al-Awsat English, Mishary Dhayidi, 29 Aug 2026), which itself frames the material as unverified circulating claims. No official source, no chain of custody, no geolocation, no timestamp verification. Charred tyres are an expected find inside any Mediterranean burn scar because forests are used for informal dumping; their presence is not diagnostic of ignition.
quarantined_out_of_scope.verification_method: direct fetch; article confirmed to be Opinion section commentary, not reporting

negative_findings: No forensic origin-and-cause examination result for any 24-29 August ignition has been published by any authority.

No arrest, detention or judicial referral tied specifically to the 24-29 August Jijel fires appears in open sources as of the reporting date. Every arrest story that could be dated resolves to July 2026 or to August 2021.

No power-utility statement on grid faults in Jijel during 23-27 August was located. The only located grid item concerns Seraidi (Annaba), where power and gas were cut PRECAUTIONARILY because of fire - an effect, not a cause.

No Directorate General of Forests (DGF) burned-area figure specific to the August event in Jijel was located; published DGF material relates to the seasonal plan and to national totals up to 20 July 2026.
osint_scope_isolation.method_note_on_official_social_accounts: The baseline report excluded social media wholesale. That rule over-reaches in one respect: the DGPC operates verified institutional pages (national and Jijel-level) on which it publishes its own situation reports. Content published by an authority on its own official channel is a Tier-1 primary source, not an unverified third-party claim. Those pages were located but could not be machine-fetched here; they are recorded as an accessible primary source for follow-up rather than used as evidence.
